propositions: normalize_ci_conclusion.sh is a pure shell function that maps (CONCLUSION, FAILURE_OBSERVED) to a vote in {success, failure, cancelled} and must be ported to a stdlib-only Python entry point

The existing subprocess-driven contract test must be re-pointed at the Python entry point while preserving its full case table, and new direct unit tests must cover the function contract including both FAILURE_OBSERVED values
gerrit-verify.yaml must update its sparse-checkout path from scripts/normalize_ci_conclusion.sh to the new Python file and update the run invocation accordingly
The Python entry point must be dependency-free so that a single-file sparse-checkout can execute without the package installed
The ported function must handle all fail-closed anomaly cases: empty CONCLUSION, unrecognized values, and skipped with FAILURE_OBSERVED states
